chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly hagiographic/biographical travel narrative about Mani’s summons by Shapur and subsequent missionary journeys, with no systematic cosmos→cosmos correspondential exposition. Two paragraphs embed a Johannine (Jn 3) light/darkness saying, which marks a Christian overlay. The chapter ends with direct audience exhortation/prayer and mention of the holy church (pastoral drift consistent with the chapter-level fatigue score).
